title: The standard affine-line compact-support exchange respects the open counit
statement: For every finite commutative coefficient ring A, base change g:S′→S and unbounded complex M in the ordinary derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] on the projective line over S, the actual standard-compactification exchange of [def-amb-affine-trace-construction] followed by the inverse-image square and the changed open counit equals pullback of the old open counit followed by projective direct-image exchange. The precise equation is in the Lean attachment; no Tate datum, projective trace, or Noetherian hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Use the existing unbounded derived inverse-image composition and identity coherence to instantiate the compact-support formalism with ordinaryFinitePullback, ordinaryFinitePushforward, and exact derived open extension. Identify its open base-change mate with derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso. Proper/open exchange is invertible by restriction to the open and its closed complement, using proper base change and vanishing of extension by zero on disjoint supports. These are the existing unbounded source-library constructions; no bounded-below passage is used.

Identify the formalism refinement comparison with the concrete rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationComparison. Transpose under the open adjunctions and use unit_map_refinementLowerShriekBaseChangeLeftDerivedIso; transport the exact pullback unit through its natural left-derived comparison. The direct-image compositor is the conjugate of the inverse-image compositor, so the common-refinement isomorphisms agree exactly. Apply refinement compatibility of compact-support base change to the isomorphism from the standard projective-line compactification to the pulled-back one. This identifies affineTraceLineExchange with the standard proper-exchange followed by inverse open-exchange formula.

Identify affineTraceOpenPullbackSquare with the inverse derived square isomorphism by the inverse-image compositor and equality transport. Identify ordinaryFiniteP1Exchange with derivedBaseChangeMap by naturality of mates under the comparison from left-derived to exact inverse image. Expand the standard compactification exchange, combine the three maps inside the changed proper pushforward, and use leftDerivedUpperStar_map_counit_derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriek. Naturality of derivedBaseChangeMap at the old open counit gives the required equation. These are equalities of unbounded functors, valid also for identity base change, empty schemes, and zero coefficients.

lean.statement:
theorem affineTraceLineExchange_openCounit (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {S' S : Scheme.{u}} (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A (ProjectiveLine S)) :
    let J := affineTraceOpenAdjunction A S
    let J' := affineTraceOpenAdjunction A S'
    affineTraceLineExchange A g
        ((ordinaryFinitePullback A (ProjectiveLine.affineChart S)).obj M) ≫
      (affineTraceLineLeft A S').map ((affineTraceOpenPullbackSquare A g).hom.app M) ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S')).map
        (J'.counit.app ((ordinaryFinitePullback A
          (ProjectiveSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) g)).obj M)) =
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A g).map
      ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).map (J.counit.app M)) ≫
        ordinaryFiniteP1Exchange A g M
